voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: In August nineteen seventy-seven, a radio telescope in Ohio picked up a signal, from the direction of Sagittarius.
It lasted seventy-two seconds. Then it stopped.
Thirty times louder than the background noise. On the frequency of hydrogen, the most common element in the universe.
The astronomer circled the printout, and wrote in the margin, one word: wow.
Despite fifty years of follow-up observations, it has never repeated.
